narration.speaker: kabir
narration.script: Hindi words in Devanagari, English/technical words in Latin script (code-mixed, e.g. 'QR code को scan करो'). No '...' mid-sentence; minimal commas. Numbers in Hindi words.
narration.split: Word/caption timing snapped to Kabir's own pauses inside each scene
narration.placement: NO extra padding between sentences; only ~0.4s between scenes. Keep it fast and thrilling.
narration.calls: One TTS call per scene (all sentences of that scene together) so flow is natural and scene boundaries are exact
narration.verify: Transcribe each scene with Sarvam saarika:v2.5 to catch mispronunciations

mix.music: energetic 112bpm: pulsing bass, 16th arps, four-on-floor kick; bgm gain 0.28, drums 0.35, ducked 70% under voice; riser + sub boom into each scene
mix.sfx: global 0.4; bubbles 0.018, flame hiss 0.01 — SFX stay ~15 dB under voice

ending.content: 'This is…' (orange This) → THE WHY? SPACES logo → 'Because every WHY deserves a story.' → Follow @thewhyspaces
ending.voice: Kabir: 'This is The Why Spaces.' (logo hits on 'The Why Spaces') + 'Because every why deserves a story.'
ending.rule: Append to EVERY video unchanged, hard cut after content. Narration scripts should NOT repeat these lines.
